terrain_gradient — DRIVE terrain op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d × table → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.terrain_gradient(x, y, p: 'dict', course=None) (to call the implementation directly, import driveterrain; driveterrain.terrain_gradient(x, y, p: 'dict', course=None); from the registry, opsdrive.get("terrain_gradient"))

Usage

Closed form of (∂z/∂x, ∂z/∂y): ∇(h·w) = w∇h + h·w′(d)·∇d, ∇d = unit vector pointing outward from the nearest point.
